high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article headline from "The Indian Express," dated one day prior to the screenshot being taken. The headline reads: "Quentin Tarantino on not directing Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel: 'It just unenthused me'." The photo accompanying the headline shows two individuals standing close together, both wearing sunglasses and dressed in dark suits. The person on the left is wearing a flat cap and has a beard, while the person on the right is wearing aviator-style sunglasses and has short hair.
